watches.description: Important! Please read our shipping policy before ordering. Please ensure that your address is accurate when placing your order. Discover Adroit, a truly distinctive automatic GMT watch that seamlessly combines style and functionality. With a 100% original, unique design, this timepiece is a testament to exquisite craftsmanship. The 48-click bezel, featuring 24-hour markings, offers precise timekeeping across time zones. But the Adroit watch does not stop there. It boasts Swiss Super-LumiNova lume for exceptional visibility in low light conditions, as well as striking red and black Japanese lume accents. The captivating sandwich dial showcases a sophisticated sand texture, adding a touch of elegance to the overall aesthetic. Designed with your comfort in mind, the watch includes two 1.5 links that ensure a perfect fit on your wrist. Embrace unparalleled precision and style with the Adroit automatic GMT watch, a truly remarkable addition to your timepiece collection. A limited edition of only 150 VBAD212 watches are available in total. IMPRESSIVE FEATURES Perfect alignment guaranteed Distinctive design featuring harmonious elements that blend seamlessly for a unified, cohesive appearance Sand-textured sandwich dial, rich in intricate details, designed for microscopical enjoyment Striking red and black Japanese lume for outstanding visibility and style 48 exceptionally sturdy clicks on the bidirectional bezel Original, stylish 316L stainless steel bracelet featuring 1.5 links for an ideal fit and quick-release spring bars Pop-open butterfly clasp: smooth operation with crisp, satisfying clicks during opening and closing WHAT YOU GET One VBAD212 watch One 316L stainless steel bracelet CASE 316L stainless steel 40mm case diameter 46.5mm lug to lug 20mm lug width 13mm thickness including crystal BEZEL 316L stainless steel Markers filled with red and black Japanese lume 48-click bidirectional rotation CRYSTAL Flat sapphire with anti-reflective (AR) coating on the inside Bevel edge CROWN Push-pull 7mm diameter Logo filled with black Japanese lume CASEBACK Screw down Display caseback Flat sapphire crystal MOVEMENT NH34 automatic movement 21600 bph 24 jewels 41 hours power reserve Hand-windable Stop second device GMT function Date Metal movement holder DIAL Sand textured gradient blue Sandwich dial Hour markers filled with C3 Swiss Super-LumiNova HANDS Custom made second, minute, hour, and GMT hands Filled with C3 Swiss Super-LumiNova BRACELET 316L stainless steel Tapering from 20mm to 18mm Quick release Pop-open push-button butterfly clasp Two 1.5 links WATER RESISTANCE 100m (10ATM) WARRANTY One year warranty from the date of shipping For more details, please see the warranty page
